name: measure_baseline
label: Measure the baseline
goal: Record the cleanliness index in the city centre before any change, with the method written down, and say where the invented series disagree.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A baseline cleanliness index is recorded with its method and its limits.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Baseline checked against the cleanliness-index table and the contradicting audit.

name: collection_design
label: Design the collection change
goal: Choose one structural change to bin capacity, collection timing or signage that fits the baseline and the operational limits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: One collection option is chosen with its cost band, owner role and operational check.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Decision record lists the option and the checks.

name: enforcement_and_comms
label: Plan enforcement and communication
goal: Plan how existing rules are explained and applied to waste placement, through clear signage and plain notices, with no group singled out.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A plain-language notice and a rule-application note are drafted and checked for fairness.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Second contributor reads both against the fairness check.

name: pilot
label: Run a small pilot
goal: Run the chosen collection change with the notices in a bounded part of the city centre for a fixed period and record what was done.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The pilot ran for the planned period in the planned area.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Implementer log and a verification note.

name: measure_result
label: Measure the result
goal: Measure the cleanliness index again with the baseline method and report the result with its limits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The cleanliness index is measured before and after with the same method.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Index in the pilot area, compared before and after.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The report states what the measurement does not show.
acceptance_criteria.measure: Report section reviewed by a second contributor.
